sections.content: Most Hungarian infinitives are formed by adding -ni to the verb stem, sometimes with a linking vowel for stems ending in a consonant cluster or certain sounds. kirándul ('to hike') plus -ni gives kirándulni.

olvas ('to read') needs a linking vowel before -ni: olvas + ni becomes olvasni with no extra vowel needed here because olvas already ends conveniently -- but many other stems do insert -a-/-e- before -ni, so always check a new verb's infinitive rather than guessing.
